execution.description: A command that turns a Graphite phase-3 winning bundle into the frozen-candidate record the Launchpad's freeze writes, through the Launchpad's own check-design, admission and record builder, with typed refusals and a byte-parity test against the Launchpad's freeze and submit.

expected: A Level-1 bundle could be refused by its contract digest, since development variants are refused by digest at every miner door.
observed: A Level-1 bundle names the base contract digest; the variant appears only in the recipe's development binding. A digest-only check would have let it through, so the converter refuses the development binding itself and scans the whole bundle for any registered variant name or digest.
keep: Reuse the miner door's own builders and prove parity by running the door on the same input, not by re-deriving the shape.
Every refusal check runs before the first write, so a refused bundle produces nothing.
change: Check a development level by its binding, not by the digest it names: the base contract digest is shared by every level.
Plan the phase-3 to mainnet path at the start of a test wave, not after the first bundle exists.
